weather_report:
Late morning in Subiaco arrives bright but textured, the sun pouring through patches of cloud that drift and rearrange the light. Expect a dry, gentle day with moments of sunshine and a softer glare when the cloud thickens after lunch; by late afternoon the sky should open a little again. Visibility looks clean and the day feels clear rather than hazy. UV will be strong through the early afternoon even with the cloud cover, the kind that sneaks up on bare forearms.

Dress in light, breathable layers with a hat and sunglasses, and keep sunscreen handy; a thin extra layer won’t go astray toward evening as the light eases. It’s the sort of day for modest ambitions: walk an errand or two, leaf through a few shelves at the library, or tend the balcony plants between sunbreaks. A late lunch outdoors under a wide awning would suit, and a slow amble home in the mellowing light should round it out comfortably.
